headline: Gazipur: Workers protest after ill employee dies following alleged leave denial
summary: Employees are demanding justice for a colleague who reportedly died after being denied leave to seek medical treatment.
details: Workers in Gazipur have launched a protest following the death of a colleague.
The protests were triggered by allegations that the employee was denied leave to seek medical treatment while ill.
The workers are demanding accountability and justice for the deceased employee.
The incident has sparked tension and anger among the staff at the workplace.
caption:
A worker's death in Gazipur sparks outrage. Colleagues claim he was denied leave to get medical help.

headline_marked: Student [[shot in the back while buying tiffin]] in Comilla
headline: Student shot in the back while buying tiffin in Comilla
summary: A 6th-grade student was caught in a crossfire between rival drug gangs in the Katabil area of Comilla city.
details: A 6th-grade student, Ethan Ahmed, was shot in the back while buying food during his school's tiffin break on Thursday afternoon in the Katabil area of Comilla city.

The bullet hit his lung, according to the acting director of Comilla Medical College Hospital. He was initially treated there before being transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced surgery to remove the bullet.
The shooting occurred during a clash between two rival groups, identified by police as the 'Apu group' and 'Sabbir group', who are fighting for control over the drug trade in the area.

The violence erupted after a human chain protest against drug dealing was organized by local residents. Armed individuals attacked the protest, leading to a clash and gunfire that injured at least five others.

Local residents reported that tensions had been rising since Wednesday night, involving chases and cocktail explosions, but police were not present in the area on Thursday morning when the shooting happened.
The Comilla Kotwali Model Police Station OC stated that the situation is now under control and police are working to identify and arrest those involved in the attack.
